sentences.text: If you put a fan behind a cold coil, you have an air conditioner.
But the cold coil pulls water from the air, and it drips onto the floor.
So you add a tray and a hose that drains the water away.
But now the coil warms up, and warm air blows into the room.
So you add a compressor that pumps coolant to keep the coil cold.
The heat goes to a hot coil and out the window.
And comfort is not why air conditioning was invented.
Willis Carrier designed it in 1902 so printing paper would not swell.
Add louvers, a display and a filter.
Congratulations, you have built an air conditioner.
